text: The 25.5-hectare tree-cover loss in 2015 was detected by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13). The loss event is classified as "SUPPORTED," meaning it meets the criteria for stand-replacing tree-cover loss (at least 30% canopy reduction). However, the exact cause—such as logging, fire, or land use change—is not specified in the data. The event occurred outside the claim interval (2021–2025), so it does not affect compliance assessments for that period. The data also show smaller losses in other years (2008, 2017, 2020) and minor post-baseline losses below the 0.5-hectare detection threshold.
